answer: An admission auction rations entry: each epoch sells 20 slots, and a newcomer must outbid rivals. Winners enter a public atlas, exposing hidden duplicates. Each slot carries one ivory token, unsplittable, unlendable, so one buy cannot serve ten agents. As the tide rises, so does the clearing price: at 40 credits a slot, 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 credits for a 25-credit reward. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and keeps the full reward.
